## VERIFIED GREEN — live run `30964805133`, **62 passed / 0 failed**

Run `30964805133` at `c3fb869ab5` (both changes merged), conclusion **success**. **Zero failures in
the entire live external suite** — the first fully-green harness run in this window.

### The three cells that had never passed in 12 consecutive runs

```
PASSED test_inbound_set_parent_round_trips
PASSED test_outbound_unrepresentable_parent_is_REPORTED_rather_than_silently_dropped
PASSED test_outbound_clear_parent_round_trips
```

12/12 FAILED across `30834117797` -> `30951453979`; **PASSED on the first run after the fix.**

### The neighbours that had to STAY green — they did

```
PASSED test_a_subtask_reparent_is_REFUSED_rather_than_silently_ignored
PASSED test_inbound_clear_parent_round_trips
PASSED test_outbound_epic_parent_round_trips_via_the_epic_link
PASSED test_outbound_epic_parent_reaches_dc_THROUGH_A_RECONCILE_PASS
PASSED test_a_repeat_pass_over_a_converged_epic_parent_plans_nothing
```

The first of those is the load-bearing one: the sub-task platform limit is **still pinned**, so the
re-home did not quietly drop the constraint — a future DC that starts accepting a sub-task
reparent still fails loudly. And the idempotence cell staying green is the evidence that the new
alert does not churn: if the emit-time record fired on a converged parent, that cell would be the
first to notice.

### Acceptance criteria

- [x] **AC1** — LIVE measurement recorded: `fields.parent` on a sub-task is accept-and-ignore; the
      supported mechanism is the Epic Link on a non-sub-task child. Run ids `30951453979` (the
      negative) and `30964805133` (the positive)
- [x] **AC2** — the emit side no longer fails silently; a suppressed non-epic parent that DIVERGES
      from the tracker records a durable `outbound-field-dropped` bridge alert
- [x] **AC3** — no write DC accepts-and-ignores is issued, and the unsupported case is now
      operator-visible rather than a silent no-op
- [x] **AC4** — `test_inbound_set_parent_round_trips` PASSES, re-homed, asserting the child ends up
      under the intended parent locally
- [x] **AC5** — `test_outbound_unrepresentable_parent_is_REPORTED...` PASSES, asserting the
      user-visible outcome for the unsupported case (alert raised AND instance unwritten)
- [x] **AC6** — no cell deleted, skipped, or xfailed; the platform limit stays pinned by two cells
- [x] **AC7** — `docs/jira-dc-capability-map.md` records the outcome with the run ids

**All seven met.** Leaving the ticket `in_progress` for operator verification as instructed —
I am not closing it.
